description: This file defines a class named 'Startup' within the Opencart system, specifically in the Admin Model Setting namespace. The class provides methods for managing startup configurations, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and updating startup records in the database. It interacts with the database directly to perform CRUD operations on the 'startup' table.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Model class for managing startup configurations in the OpenCart admin setting namespace.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Inserts a new startup record into the database with provided code, description, action, status, and sort order. Returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by its startup ID.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes startup records matching the specified code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup record identified by startup ID.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its startup ID.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Fetches a list of startup records with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total count of startup records.
